parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of same-sex conduct or gender expression, no trans-specific offence, no documented border/facility ban, and a positive institutional signal (health ministry deeming trans identity not a disorder; 2022 conversion-practice ban; supportive public opinion; openly operating NGOs). But there is no anti-discrimination protection or operative legal recognition, and the dossier documents current harms: routine healthcare-encounter discrimination and humiliation of trans women, staff scrutinising ID mismatch, unquantified stigma-driven violence risk in outlying provinces, no identity-congruent custody placement (solitary or general population only, reform never enacted), NGOs under surveillance, and 2025 Pride cancellations signalling a state clampdown. No working remedy is documented for any of these. Lacking a documented universal exclusion or organised targeting, it sits above the 0.45 tier but below jurisdictions showing partial, functioning recourse — elevated risk.
